text_blocks.snippet: Yes, individuals with HIV can live long and healthy lives with proper antiretroviral therapy (ART). With early diagnosis and consistent treatment, the life expectancy of someone with HIV is now comparable to that of someone without the virus. While HIV itself is not curable, ART effectively suppresses the virus, preventing progression to AIDS and allowing individuals to live long, healthy lives.
